format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-tile-metric id="swap" label="Подкачка" value="83" max="100" format="integer" unit="%" warning-at="80" error-at="95" hint="Серверу не хватает памяти"></sf-tile-metric>
<sf-tile-metric id="visits" label="Посетители" value="12480" previous="11020" format="integer" period-text="к прошлой неделе" href="#traffic"></sf-tile-metric>
<sf-tile-metric id="cpu" label="Нагрузка процессора" value="0.64" previous="0.41" format="percent" better="down" delta-format="absolute"></sf-tile-metric>
<sf-tile-metric id="disk" label="Диск" value="45" max="100" format="integer" openable></sf-tile-metric>

probes.title: a plain tile is a group named by its label; swap 83 of 100 with warning-at 80 is a warning by itself, its meter says the limit
probes.covers: accessibility.role group, settings.label, settings.max, settings.warning-at, host-states data-status

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#swap'); const root = el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-tile-metric'); const meter = el.querySelector('[role=meter]'); return root.getAttribute('role') === 'group' && document.getElementById(root.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent === 'Подкачка' && el.getAttribute('data-status') === 'warning' && meter.getAttribute('aria-valuemax') === '100' && meter.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '83' && el.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-status-icon').textContent === 'warning' && el.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-hint').textContent === 'Серверу не хватает памяти' && el.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-unit').textContent === '%'; })()

probes.title: the change is worked out from previous, toned by better and said in words; a link tile is one link

steps.check: (() => { const v = document.querySelector('#visits'); const c = document.querySelector('#cpu'); const link = v.querySelector(':scope > a.sf-tile-metric'); return link && link.getAttribute('href') === '#traffic' && !link.querySelector('a, button') && v.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-change').getAttribute('data-tone') === 'positive' && v.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-delta .sr-only').textContent === 'рост' && v.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-period').textContent === 'к прошлой неделе' && c.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-change').getAttribute('data-tone') === 'negative'; })()

probes.title: an openable tile is one native button that sends open with the element's id
loading keeps the label and draws skeleton bars with aria-busy; no value reads «—» and no label reads «Показатель»

steps.check: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('#wait'); const n = document.querySelector('#none'); return w.getAttribute('data-loading') === 'true' && w.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric').getAttribute('aria-busy') === 'true' && w.querySelectorAll('.sf-tile-metric-skeleton').length === 2 && w.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-label').textContent === 'Очередь' && n.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-value').textContent === '—' && n.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-label').textContent === 'Показатель'; })()

probes.title: the chart slot keeps the page's own node, live

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#chart'); const spark = document.getElementById('spark'); return spark && el.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-chart').contains(spark) && !el.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-chart').hidden; })()
